scope: Revalidate scalar explanation routes after a real fitted model replacement; not a test of SHAP/LIME fidelity or diagnosis
comparison: Use _manual_equal_evidence with same signed evidence, score tolerance and semantic metadata as the route verifier
unit_of_analysis: Nine fitted model pairs, with test predictions nested by model; four correlated cases per prediction
limitations: Controlled model changes are developer-known, not independently blinded production faults
Signing keys and synthetic scalar route stages are provided by the same experiment process
No claim of predictive validity, XAI faithfulness, clinical safety, cost reduction or advantage over same-evidence rules
Call timings include only route validation, not fitting, inference, explaining, I/O, or human work
